name: Hydra Console Ports Source
description: Independent discovery feed for console-to-PC projects and public listing metadata; GitHub release assets are resolved live in the Hydra app. No copyrighted game binaries are mirrored.

entries.title: Bloodborne — PC build listing
entries.description: Community full-build listing for the unofficial Bloodborne PC experience. External listing; this index does not host or verify installers.

entries.title: Bloodborne — Native Windows Port
entries.description: Experimental Windows native CPU loader and Vulkan renderer. Requires a compatible Bloodborne dump; check the project README and release status.

entries.title: Bloodborne — bbhost
entries.description: Independent Bloodborne desktop research/runtime project. Check developer instructions and available releases; original assets may be required.

entries.title: King Kong — Recompiled
entries.description: Community native PC recompilation project for Peter Jackson's King Kong from Xbox 360.

entries.title: Ship of Harkinian — Ocarina of Time
entries.description: Native PC port project with official GitHub releases. Requires legally acquired original game assets.

entries.title: Starship — Star Fox 64
entries.description: Community Star Fox 64 native desktop port. Releases require the user's own original assets.

entries.title: Super Mario 64 — sm64ex
entries.description: Community Super Mario 64 native desktop port. Project instructions explain how to build with legally obtained original assets.

entries.title: OpenGOAL — Jak & Daxter
entries.description: Open-source Jak and Daxter runtime and launcher project.

entries.title: Sonic 1 & 2 (2013) — RSDKv4

entries.description: Reverse-engineered engine and PC port project.
